name: insta-edits
description: Let Claude edit your Instagram Reels in Edits for Mac: cut to the beat, captions, text, transitions, zooms and export, with the full 274-tool editor. Keeps Claude's tool list in sync and your token in the keychain.

edits_token.title: Edits access token
edits_token.description: In Edits: Settings > Automation > Enable Automation Server, then copy the Access token. Stored in your system keychain, never in a file or a chat.
